::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 12th [1867]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 185
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
[Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd) tells me you are going to America. Should you go to Philadelphia, and if so would it be very troublesome to take charge of a roll of paper containing an illumination that cannot be trusted by post?[^1]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Macmillan agreed to take the parcel to CMY’s correspondent [Miss Lewis](people/person_873.qmd), of 710 Pine St., Philadelphia.
